title: The Morning Digest: October 23, 2026
dek: Brent Dec26 settled Thursday at $113.17 (up $4.35), its highest since May 4, and bid overnight to $114.47 at 0639 GMT (Reuters), with WTI Dec26 at $100.84. Aramco evacuated its Dhahran headquarters on Thursday, the first such order since February, with no disruption to operations reported. The death toll from Wednesday's Dammam airport attack was updated to two killed. The Revolutionary Guards' claim of seven vessels hit or mined remains unconfirmed on its second day, and US Central Command called the mine claims incorrect. The first Russian diesel cargo under the sanctions waiver loaded at Primorsk on Thursday and is heading for New York. The diesel crack closed Thursday at $107.68. WCS Dec26 settled at -$27.85 (ICE TMW settle, Oct 22), tightening on 515 lots. The synthetic crude verdict scheduled for today does not score, because December synthetic settled on zero volume for a third straight day.
